jobs.prompt: After the third-review fixes (commit 'wip aanew5') six tests in tests/auto-approve.test.mjs fail: 'security (1): push only to origin for this repository', 'security (6): commit amend and hook-skipping forms denied', 'finding 1: denied policy push verdict and owner+policy guard check', 'finding 10: commit then push within HEAD ancestry window', 'opus2 (9): read-only git and git add allowed under policy window', 'opus3 M5: git add requires window path and rejects magic pathspec'. The new rules are right (git environment variables refused, effective config checked under the real environment and fail closed, executable must be exactly git, git add only for literal paths covered by the window, no commit -F or --author, opaque ops denied, URL double colon refused). For each failing test find whether the production code over-denies a flow the docs promise (commit then push within the HEAD ancestry window, read-only git and git add of covered literal paths, push of the current feat or swarm branch to origin of the owner-configured repository) and fix the code, or whether the test fixture simply no longer satisfies a new requirement (for example the fixture needs a clean environment, an owner-configured trusted URL, a literal covered path, or a repo whose effective config is on the allow-list): then update the fixture, never the assertion of a deny. Keep every deny the review required. Run the whole auto-approve file, the orchestrator-mode, handbuild, guard and self-approval tests, and make them all pass.
